cohort: The study included seventy healthy women with term uncomplicated pregnancies, all delivered by scheduled cesarean delivery.
finding: Significant correlations were found between uteroplacental uptake and fetal uptake of glucose within tertiles of placental glucose consumption, indicating that the uteroplacenta's own treatment of glucose affects net fetal glucose uptake independently of the maternal-fetal glucose gradient.
cross-section timing: At term during scheduled cesarean delivery
